minetorio.ponder.head_3x3.text_1: Start with a Drill Head Base block. It is the carriage that the Mechanical Piston moves.
minetorio.ponder.head_3x3.text_2: Under it, stack 5 Drill Head blocks in one column and glue everything together with Super Glue.
minetorio.ponder.head_3x3.text_3: When the drive is turning, a rotating bit shaped like this appears around the lower blocks. It never breaks blocks.
minetorio.ponder.head_5x5.text_1: Start with a Drill Head Base block. It is the carriage that the Mechanical Piston moves.
minetorio.ponder.head_5x5.text_2: Under it, stack 8 Drill Head blocks in one column and glue everything together with Super Glue.
minetorio.ponder.head_5x5.text_3: When the drive is turning, a rotating bit shaped like this appears around the lower blocks. It never breaks blocks.
minetorio.ponder.drill_3x3.text_1: Quarry drills work on ore patches. Build the drill right above the ore.
minetorio.ponder.drill_3x3.text_2: A Mechanical Piston facing down lowers the drill. Every Piston Extension Pole behind it adds one block of reach.
minetorio.ponder.drill_3x3.text_3: Put the Drill Head Base block right under the piston.
minetorio.ponder.drill_3x3.text_4: Stack 5 Drill Head blocks under it and glue them all together.
minetorio.ponder.drill_3x3.text_5: Power the piston: it lowers the drill until the lowest block touches the ore.
minetorio.ponder.drill_3x3.text_6: A rotating bit appears around the blocks and spins with the drive. It never breaks blocks.
minetorio.ponder.drill_3x3.text_7: The drive needs 1024 SU at 32 RPM. At 32 RPM it yields 1 ore block and 1 raw ore every 5 minutes; every extra 32 RPM multiplies that. Each cycle wears the ore block down by 1.
minetorio.ponder.drill_3x3.text_8: Place the drive with right-click to make the red-dot output face you, or while sneaking to face away. Ore is pushed into an adjacent chest or belt.
minetorio.ponder.drill_5x5.text_1: Quarry drills work on ore patches. Build the drill right above the ore.
minetorio.ponder.drill_5x5.text_2: A Mechanical Piston facing down lowers the drill. Every Piston Extension Pole behind it adds one block of reach.
minetorio.ponder.drill_5x5.text_3: Put the Drill Head Base block right under the piston.
minetorio.ponder.drill_5x5.text_4: Stack 8 Drill Head blocks under it and glue them all together.
minetorio.ponder.drill_5x5.text_5: Power the piston: it lowers the drill until the lowest block touches the ore.
minetorio.ponder.drill_5x5.text_6: A rotating bit appears around the blocks and spins with the drive. It never breaks blocks.
minetorio.ponder.drill_5x5.text_7: The drive needs 1536 SU at 32 RPM. At 32 RPM it yields 2 ore blocks and 3 raw ore every 5 minutes; every extra 32 RPM multiplies that. Each cycle wears the ore block down by 1.
minetorio.ponder.drill_5x5.text_8: Place the drive with right-click to make the red-dot output face you, or while sneaking to face away. Ore is pushed into an adjacent chest or belt.
